While on loan in League Two, I played the full 90 minutes as we knocked Leicester City out of the FA Cup.
Years later I scored the only goal in an FA Cup final to secure a trophy for my club.
I've been managed by Andoni Iraola & Pep Guardiola.

style.why: This reads exactly like one of Lewis's originals: it tells a story with a clear arc (loan cup upset -> years later winning the final) and closes with a narrowing clue that mixes a current manager with a famous one to pinpoint the player. The hook is memorable and surprising for a casual fan, not a D
